lines.en: Today we will paint a flower. Do you like flowers?
lines.ko: 오늘은 꽃을 그릴 거예요. 꽃을 좋아하세요?

lines.en: Yes, I do. I drew a tree last week.
I remember. Did you finish it at home?
Yes, I completed it after dinner last night.
lines.ko: 네, 어젯밤 저녁 먹고 나서 완성했어요.

lines.en: Good. First, draw the shape with a pencil.
Teacher, which color should I use?
Choose any color you like. And paint slowly.
lines.ko: 좋아하는 색을 고르세요. 그리고 천천히 칠하세요.

lines.en: I will make it pink and yellow.
Beautiful. Will you design a card with it?
Yes, I will prepare it for my daughter.
lines.ko: 네, 딸에게 줄 카드를 준비할 거예요.

lines.en: Grandma, let's make a paper boat!
Good idea. What do we need?
We need paper. I will get some.
Great. Now shape it like this.
Like this? Did you make boats when you were young?
lines.ko: 이렇게요? 할머니도 어릴 때 배를 만들었어요?

lines.en: Yes, I made many paper boats in those days.
lines.ko: 네, 그 시절에 종이배를 많이 만들었어요.

lines.en: Cool! Can we draw a face on it?
Sure. Draw it, and I will paint the side.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 얼굴을 그려요, 옆면은 내가 칠할게요.

lines.en: Now it's finished! Let's create a house too.
Okay. We will complete it after lunch.
